daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is hitting different for you—your intuition is sharp and you're picking up on things others miss. The Moon in Cancer wants you to honor your feelings instead of glossing over them. Trust that gut feeling.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is bringing warmth to your connections today. If you've been holding back, now's the time to be a little more open. Your authenticity is magnetic right now, so let people see the real you.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo is pushing ambitious energy into the room, and you can tap into that focus. Channel it into something you actually care about rather than just grinding for the sake of it. Quality over hustle.
daily.health: The Moon in Cancer is calling for some genuine self-care—not the performative kind. Rest, hydrate, and do something that feels nourishing. Your nervous system will thank you for the slowdown.

weekly.overview: This week hits different, Pisces. The Moon moves from practical Taurus into curious Gemini, then into Leo's spotlight—your creativity is ON. Mars conjuncts Jupiter early week (Nov 22-23), amplifying your drive, while the Sun trines Saturn on the 27th, grounding your wildest dreams into actual plans. Best Day: Nov 27. Watch-Out Day: Nov 24 when Sun squares Mars—potential friction between wanting it all and knowing your limits.
weekly.love: Early week's Mars-Jupiter conjunction is flirting energy personified—if you're single, you're magnetic. If coupled, your partner notices the shift. Midweek the Moon in Gemini keeps things light and playful; lean into it. By the weekend, Venus sextile Jupiter softens everything, making this ideal for deeper conversations or finally making that move you've been considering.
weekly.career: Mars shifting into Virgo (happening this week) is your sign to get detailed and organized—big-picture thinking meets execution mode. The Sun trine Saturn on the 27th rewards work you've already put in; expect recognition or progress. Early week might feel chaotic with competing priorities, but midweek brings clarity. This is prime time for finishing projects or pitching ideas.
weekly.health: The Moon's journey through Taurus early week favors grounding practices—yoga, walks, actual rest. Mars-Jupiter can make you feel invincible but overextend carefully; burnout is real. By the 27th, Saturn's influence brings sustainable habits into focus. Prioritize sleep and hydration over heroic effort. Your nervous system will thank you.
